# LeakSanitizer suppressions for mdparser CI.
#
# Format: "leak:<substring>"; the substring must appear in a frame of
# the leak's stack trace.
#
# Empty: the ASan CI job has found no process-lifetime allocations so
# far. Add narrow entries for known-good leaks (e.g. vendored-library
# MINIT singletons) instead of setting detect_leaks=0 in
# .github/workflows/tests.yml. See
# ~/ai/wiki/debugging/asan-php-extension.md.
#
# To audit a new leak locally:
#   ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=1 LSAN_OPTIONS=fast_unwind_on_malloc=0 \
#     <asan-php> -d extension=mdparser.so -r '<repro>'
